'''Hootkins''' was a pilot of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, he was on patrol in a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]], along with an unnamed rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. The two Rebel pilots did not detect anything on their patrol route and were preparing to return to base when the pilot detected some unusual readings on his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Hootkins, however, did not initially detect anything and the two pilots were closing their B-wings' [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] when they came under attack. Both starfighters were destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
Hootkins made his only appearance in a tech demo for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''. The short video was originally created as a test of video production and compression technology, but was distributed as a trailer for the game with other LucasArts titles. It was also included with ''Rebel Assault II'' itself as an alternative opening video, accessible by holding down the 'B', 'O', and 'T' keys while selecting "Continue Intro" from the game's menu.
